solver.name: micromamba
solver.command: micromamba create --no-rc --no-env --root-prefix <temporary-root> --prefix <temporary-prefix> --platform <subdir> --override-channels -c conda-forge --strict-channel-priority --dry-run --json gtk4=4.24.2 libsoup=3.6.6 glib-networking adwaita-icon-theme fonts-conda-ecosystem

selection: The complete authoritative solver transaction is locked below. The builder excludes Python/build-only sources, then retains the transitive ELF DT_NEEDED closure of GTK4, libsoup, runtime modules, graphics dispatch libraries, and cache tools, plus their runtime data and all contributing component licenses. No Conda libc or loader is included.

data_sources.selection: Explicit data-only exception: conda-forge has no shared-mime-info package. Include share/mime and its copyright; no Debian executables, libraries or libc are distributed. Generate architecture-independent cache with update-mime-database 2.4 at build time.
